rows.text: Conocer la carga y las instrucciones permite adoptar precauciones adecuadas, por ejemplo para mercancías peligrosas o delicadas.
evidence: UK Department for Transport/DVSA, dangerous goods transport https://www.gov.uk/guidance/driving-dangerous-goods-and-special-loads and https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/adr/adr-instructions-in-writing — applicable ADR dangerous-goods carriage requires crew-readable written emergency instructions and information on hazards; example scoped to dangerous goods, not all cargo or Italian law.

rows.text: El conductor debe respetar los límites de velocidad: responde por el exceso de velocidad, aunque otros también pueden responder según las circunstancias.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 142, https://www.normattiva.it/atto/caricaDettaglioAtto?atto.articolo.numero=142&atto.codiceRedazionale=092G0306&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=1992-05-18: sanzioni per chi supera i limiti di velocità.

rows.text: El conductor que circula con un vehículo sobrecargado puede ser sancionado; las normas también prevén responsabilidades para otras personas.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 167, https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627: sanzioni per circolazione con massa eccedente e responsabilità previste per altri soggetti.

rows.text: El conductor debe respetar los períodos de conducción y descanso aplicables; la empresa también tiene obligaciones al organizar el trabajo y puede responder por las infracciones.
evidence: Reg. (CE) 561/2006, artt. 6-10, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2006/561/2024-12-31/eng/; CGUE C-287/14, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:62014CJ0287: obblighi di guida e riposo e possibile responsabilità del conducente accanto a quella dell’impresa.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERDADERO, pero no identifica el documento de transporte. Las fuentes no establecen una firma universal del conductor en el DDT fiscal ordinario; verifica los requisitos y firmas del documento aplicable al viaje.
evidence: DPR 472/1996 art.1(3), original version https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/vediMenuHTML?atto.codiceRedazionale=096G0487&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=1996-09-12&tipoSerie=serie_generale&tipoVigenza=originario — required fiscal DDT particulars, no general driver-signature item.

rows.text: Un contrato indefinido no exime al conductor: por ejemplo, responde personalmente si supera un límite de velocidad durante el transporte.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 142, https://www.normattiva.it/atto/caricaDettaglioAtto?atto.articolo.numero=142&atto.codiceRedazionale=092G0306&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=1992-05-18: sanzioni per chi supera i limiti di velocità.

rows.text: El plazo de entrega depende del acuerdo y las circunstancias también para mercancías no perecederas; no hay una facultad general de retrasar la entrega.
evidence: UNECE Convention on the Contract for the International Carriage of Goods by Road (CMR), arts.17–19 and 21, https://unece.org/DAM/trans/conventn/cmr_e.pdf — contractual delivery timing, carrier liability and cash-on-delivery collection in applicable international carriage. Does not establish universal rules for every domestic contract or driver personally; learner text states practical conditional duties.

Il tipo di documento e il fondamento dell’obbligo non sono precisati.

issues.reason: The explanation merely restates the source definition without explaining the curve’s use or interpreting how torque changes with engine speed. Add a concrete source-supported educational reason or example.

The cited Volvo source describes specific engines and low-speed efficiency but does not substantiate the claim about many engines or locate general maximum efficiency near maximum torque. Scope the example to the inspected engine and make the limit explicit.

The cited CMR articles concern carrier liability and delivery, and the civil-code citation does not establish the specific dangerous-goods driver precaution claimed. Provide a directly applicable accessible ADR source for the example or narrow it to the verified evidence.

The learner text states the fiscal DDT signature is not essential without qualifying the 2010 circular’s historical identified-preparer/equivalence context. The source does not establish an unrestricted current rule for every DDT. Qualify the context and distinguish documents, consistent with 30999.
